audited_claim: The repeatable Red loop demonstrates authentic outcome adaptation and one teacher-free controller action, but not novel-state generalization, deterministic-baseline superiority, multi-turn battle competence, or transfer readiness.

decision.next_falsifier: On prospectively varied, semantic-cluster-disjoint authentic Red contexts, the challenger must beat the legal fixed-power heuristic before multi-turn gameplay authority can be promoted.
decision.reason: The challenger improved over its synthetic predecessor but lost the strongest available deterministic-baseline comparison, and the fresh rehearsal was not semantically novel.
